lines.en: Dragging a broken leg, step by step...
A gurgle squeezes from my throat...

lines.zh: 快帮我止血，我快不行了！
我跑得再快，伤口也在烂。
lines.en: Run as I might, the wound still rots.

lines.zh: 腐肉的诱惑让奔尸饥肠辘辘。
饥饿驱使奔尸寻找食物。
lines.en: Hunger drives the runner to find food.

lines.zh: 奔尸闻到了未腐烂肉的味道。
腐肉的气味让奔尸疯狂。
lines.en: The stench of decay drives the runner mad.
The runner craves the decayed flesh.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道让奔尸更加凶残。
lines.en: The taste of decay makes the runner more vicious.

lines.zh: 奔尸的视线锁定一块腐肉。
lines.en: The runner's gaze locks onto a piece of flesh.

lines.zh: 腐肉是奔尸唯一的希望。
lines.en: Decay is the runner's only hope.
The runner stares intently at a piece of flesh.
The runner collides with a rock.
The runner knocks down a tree.
The runner crashes into a wall.
The runner collides with a pile of logs.

lines.zh: 奔尸撞上了地上的岩石。
lines.en: The runner collides with a rock on the ground.

lines.zh: 奔尸撞上了另一只奔尸。
lines.en: The runner collides with another runner.
The runner collides with a branch.
The runner collides with a sand pile.
The runner collides with a pile of bones.
The runner makes a mating call.

lines.zh: 奔尸与另一只奔尸交配。
lines.en: The runner mates with another runner.
The runner howls a mating call.

lines.zh: 奔尸的求偶声惊扰了其他生物。
lines.en: The runner's mating call startles other creatures.

lines.zh: 奔尸的求偶声被风吹散。
lines.en: The runner's mating call is carried away by the wind.

lines.zh: 奔尸的求偶声在夜晚响起。
lines.en: The runner's mating call rings at night.

lines.zh: 奔尸的求偶声回应了同类。
lines.en: The runner's mating call is answered.

lines.zh: 奔尸的求偶声吸引了另一只奔尸。
lines.en: The runner's mating call attracts another runner.

lines.zh: 骨骼般的嘶吼响彻山间
lines.en: Skeletal howl echoes in the mountains
When I run, my knees click.

lines.zh: 腐烂的指尖在石缝间抓挠
lines.en: Rotting fingertips scratch in the cracks

lines.zh: 我在垃圾堆里翻出一只鞋。
lines.en: I dig a single shoe out of the trash heap.
Target appears, it begins to approach
Target locked, it prepares to attack

lines.zh: 目标就在眼前，它要吃掉
lines.en: Target in sight, it wants to eat
Target captured, it prepares to bite

lines.zh: 猎物已被锁定，它会追击

lines.en: Target found, it starts to run
Target locked, it prepares to act

lines.zh: 锁定的猎物就在不远处

lines.en: It locks target, ready to attack

lines.zh: 目标已被确认，它准备捕食
lines.en: Target confirmed, it prepares to feed

lines.zh: 我咬过的人，都跑不快了。
lines.en: Those I bite stop running well.

lines.zh: 你回头了，我就不客气了……
lines.en: You looked back; now I won't hold back...

lines.zh: 这条街上的活人只剩你……
lines.en: You're the last living thing on this street...

lines.zh: 我贴着你留下的血迹走。
lines.en: I follow the blood trail you left.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，准备发动攻击
它正在瞄准你身上的伤口

lines.en: I stare at the old wound on your leg...
Don't run; you won't get far...
One step from you, one step from me...

lines.zh: 我的手指在抽，想抓住东西……
lines.en: My fingers twitch to grab something...
You're panting harder than I am...

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一下一下……
lines.en: I count your steps, one by one...

lines.zh: 你的影子先被我踩住了……
lines.en: I've stepped on your shadow first...

lines.zh: 血从你袖口滴下来，我看见了……
lines.en: Blood drips from your sleeve; I see it...

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里还卡着别人的布。
lines.en: Someone else's cloth is still stuck between my teeth.
I catch your wrist and bite first.

lines.zh: 一口咬下去，你跑不掉了……
lines.en: One bite, and you won't run again...

lines.zh: 牙齿陷进小腿，血喷出来……
lines.en: Teeth sink into your calf, blood spurts...

lines.zh: 我一推，你就摔进了瓦砾……
lines.en: One shove and you're in the rubble...

lines.zh: 我的指甲撕开你的袖子……
lines.en: My nails rip your sleeve open...
I pin you down; you can't move...
I woke up starving, and I was already running.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，腿上的烂肉直甩。
lines.en: At a sprint, the rot on my legs flaps.
In the ruins, a hand pushes up...
Another one stands up in the street...
I crawl out of the corpse pile...
Burning, but I can still chase...

lines.zh: 我拖着断腿，还在往前跑。
lines.en: Dragging a broken leg, I still run on.

lines.zh: 饿得不行了，快给我食物！
雷顺着脊椎，一路烧下去。
lines.en: The bolt ran down my spine and burned.
